blocks.name: one
blocks.notes: Represents 100% of the heating or cooling request.

blocks.name: heat_pump_heating
blocks.notes: Assigns the selected share of hot-water demand to the heat pump.

blocks.name: heat_pump_cooling
blocks.notes: Assigns the selected share of chilled-water demand to the heat pump.

blocks.name: boiler
blocks.notes: Meets the remaining hot-water demand with the boiler.

blocks.name: chiller
blocks.notes: Meets the remaining chilled-water demand with the chiller.

blocks.name: pump_zero
blocks.notes: Stops both loop pumps when their CDL enable is false.

blocks.name: pump_start_threshold
blocks.notes: Requires more than 0.5 kW of load before enabling a loop.

blocks.name: hot_water_pump_needed
blocks.notes: Enables hot-water circulation from the measured heating request.

blocks.name: chilled_water_pump_needed
blocks.notes: Enables chilled-water circulation from the measured cooling request.

blocks.name: hot_water_pump_select
blocks.notes: Selects the hot-water pump command from its CDL enable.

blocks.name: chilled_water_pump_select
blocks.notes: Selects the chilled-water pump command from its CDL enable.

blocks.name: hot_water_supply_setpoint
blocks.notes: Commands a 45 °C hot-water supply temperature until a reset sequence is added.

blocks.name: chilled_water_supply_setpoint
blocks.notes: Commands a 7 °C chilled-water supply temperature until a reset sequence is added.

blocks.name: source_zero
blocks.notes: Minimum heat or cooling production command is zero kilowatts.

blocks.name: hot_water_source_error
blocks.notes: Hot-water supply target minus measured temperature.

blocks.name: chilled_water_source_error
blocks.notes: Measured chilled-water supply temperature minus its target.

blocks.name: hot_water_source_gain
blocks.notes: Corrects hot-water production by 6 kW per kelvin of supply error; editable for the 5,000 kg volume.

blocks.name: chilled_water_source_gain
blocks.notes: Corrects chilled-water production by 6 kW per kelvin of supply error; editable for the 5,000 kg volume.

blocks.name: hot_water_source_sum
blocks.notes: Adds hot-water temperature correction to the predicted heating load.

blocks.name: chilled_water_source_sum
blocks.notes: Adds chilled-water temperature correction to the predicted cooling load.

blocks.name: hot_water_source_nonnegative
blocks.notes: Prevents a negative hot-water source production command.

blocks.name: chilled_water_source_nonnegative
blocks.notes: Prevents a negative chilled-water source production command.

blocks.name: heat_pump_hot_eligible
blocks.notes: Offer hot-water demand to dispatch only after measured hot-water flow is proven.

blocks.name: heat_pump_chilled_eligible
blocks.notes: Offer chilled-water demand to dispatch only after measured chilled-water flow is proven.

blocks.name: heat_pump_utilization_limit
blocks.notes: Editable fraction of available equipment capacity offered to the heat pump. Legacy dispatch tuning migrates here; it no longer splits every demand by a fixed share.

blocks.name: heat_pump_zero_capacity
blocks.notes: Do not offer negative heat-pump capacity.

blocks.name: heat_pump_capacity_nonnegative
blocks.notes: Clamp edited utilization at zero.

blocks.name: heat_pump_capacity_limited
blocks.notes: Never offer more than physical available capacity.

blocks.name: heat_pump_total_load
blocks.notes: Total hot and chilled source demand.

blocks.name: heat_pump_divisor_floor
blocks.notes: Avoid division by zero when the plant is idle.

blocks.name: heat_pump_safe_total
blocks.notes: Positive denominator for allocation.

blocks.name: heat_pump_capacity_ratio
blocks.notes: Available capacity divided by total demand.

blocks.name: heat_pump_full_fraction
blocks.notes: Do not command above either water-loop demand.

blocks.name: heat_pump_allocated_fraction
blocks.notes: Share of each load served by the heat pump within combined capacity.

blocks.name: boiler_residual
blocks.notes: Boiler serves the hot-water load left after heat-pump allocation.

blocks.name: chiller_residual
blocks.notes: Chiller serves the chilled-water load left after heat-pump allocation.

blocks.name: heat_pump_mode_threshold
blocks.notes: Any positive heat-pump service request selects an operating mode.

blocks.name: heat_pump_heating_requested
blocks.notes: Heating demand is active.

blocks.name: heat_pump_cooling_requested
blocks.notes: Cooling demand is active.

blocks.name: heat_pump_heating_mode_code
blocks.notes: One when heating is requested.

blocks.name: heat_pump_cooling_mode_code
blocks.notes: One when cooling is requested.

blocks.name: heat_pump_mode_cooling_weight
blocks.notes: Cooling contributes two to the requested-mode code.

blocks.name: heat_pump_cooling_mode_weight
blocks.notes: Encode cooling as mode two.

blocks.name: heat_pump_mode_sum
blocks.notes: Mode 0 off, 1 heating, 2 cooling, or 3 simultaneous service.

blocks.name: ahu_1_valve_request
blocks.notes: One chilled-water reset request when the cooling valve exceeds 95%; clear below 85%.

blocks.name: ahu_1_valve_request_count
blocks.notes: Convert the qualified valve request to integer zero or one.

blocks.name: ahu_1_supply_error
blocks.notes: Actual supply air temperature minus its target.

blocks.name: ahu_1_two_request_threshold
blocks.notes: Two requests after a persistent 2 K cooling deficit.

blocks.name: ahu_1_three_request_threshold
blocks.notes: Three requests after a persistent 3 K cooling deficit.

blocks.name: ahu_1_two_request_error
blocks.notes: Supply air misses its target by more than 2 K.

blocks.name: ahu_1_three_request_error
blocks.notes: Supply air misses its target by more than 3 K.

blocks.name: ahu_1_two_request_delay
blocks.notes: Require two minutes of two-request supply-air error.

blocks.name: ahu_1_three_request_delay
blocks.notes: Require two minutes of three-request supply-air error.

blocks.name: ahu_1_request_two
blocks.notes: Two chilled-water reset requests.

blocks.name: ahu_1_request_three
blocks.notes: Three chilled-water reset requests.

blocks.name: ahu_1_select_two_requests
blocks.notes: Raise one valve request to two after a persistent supply-air error.

blocks.name: ahu_1_select_three_requests
blocks.notes: Raise the AHU request to three after a larger persistent error.

blocks.name: ahu_2_valve_request
blocks.notes: One chilled-water reset request when the cooling valve exceeds 95%; clear below 85%.

blocks.name: ahu_2_valve_request_count
blocks.notes: Convert the qualified valve request to integer zero or one.

blocks.name: ahu_2_supply_error
blocks.notes: Actual supply air temperature minus its target.

blocks.name: ahu_2_two_request_threshold
blocks.notes: Two requests after a persistent 2 K cooling deficit.

blocks.name: ahu_2_three_request_threshold
blocks.notes: Three requests after a persistent 3 K cooling deficit.

blocks.name: ahu_2_two_request_error
blocks.notes: Supply air misses its target by more than 2 K.

blocks.name: ahu_2_three_request_error
blocks.notes: Supply air misses its target by more than 3 K.

blocks.name: ahu_2_two_request_delay
blocks.notes: Require two minutes of two-request supply-air error.

blocks.name: ahu_2_three_request_delay

blocks.name: ahu_2_request_three
blocks.notes: Three chilled-water reset requests.

blocks.name: ahu_2_select_two_requests
blocks.notes: Raise one valve request to two after a persistent supply-air error.

blocks.name: ahu_2_select_three_requests
blocks.notes: Raise the AHU request to three after a larger persistent error.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_request_count
blocks.notes: Sum chilled-water temperature reset requests from both AHUs.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_request_real
blocks.notes: Convert integer requests for sampled arithmetic.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_ignored_requests
blocks.notes: Ignore the first two AHU requests.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_excess_requests
blocks.notes: Requests above the ignored count.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_zero_requests
blocks.notes: Clamp negative excess request count to zero.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_positive_requests
blocks.notes: Keep only requests above the ignored count.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_response_gain
blocks.notes: Raise normalized plant reset by 0.03 per excess request each sample.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_max_response
blocks.notes: Cap the response per sample.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_bounded_response
blocks.notes: Cap the total response per sample.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_trim
blocks.notes: Trim reset down when requests do not justify a response.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_delta
blocks.notes: Combine trim and response.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_previous
blocks.notes: Hold the previous five-minute plant reset; breaks the feedback cycle.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_sum
blocks.notes: Apply trim and response to the previous sampled reset.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_limit
blocks.notes: Keep the plant reset between zero and one.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_initial
blocks.notes: Restore the initial reset while chilled water is disabled.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_enabled
blocks.notes: Hold the initial reset when the chilled-water loop is disabled.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_temperature_start
blocks.notes: Supply-temperature reset begins after pressure reset reaches its upper limit.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_temperature_excess
blocks.notes: Fraction of sampled plant reset above the pressure-only half.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_temperature_zero
blocks.notes: Keep supply temperature at its warm limit during pressure reset.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_temperature_positive
blocks.notes: Clamp temperature-reset progress to zero before the halfway point.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_temperature_scale
blocks.notes: Map the upper half of sampled reset to a zero-to-one temperature-reset fraction.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_inverse
blocks.notes: Available warm-water reset above the minimum supply temperature.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_warm_delta
blocks.notes: Five-kelvin adjustable chilled-water supply reset range for this equipment model.

blocks.name: chilled_reset_supply_sum
blocks.notes: Add the reset allowance to the existing editable 7°C minimum target.

Shared four-pipe plant: the heat pump serves a configurable fraction of heating and cooling demand; boiler and chiller cover the remainder. Equipment-specific CDL allocation shares available heat-pump capacity across hot and chilled demand and commands boiler/chiller for the residual. The physical simulator approximates simultaneous compressor energy without a calibrated refrigerant model. The G36 sample aggregates AHU chilled-water requests and resets the supply target every five minutes. AHU hot-water requests reset the supply target every five minutes between 44 and 50 °C. Persistent VAV reheat demand contributes requests to the hot-water reset. AHU Stage 1 freeze protection contributes hot-water reset requests. Stage 3 freeze shutdown energizes chilled-water pumping. Physical pump running status, measured loop water flow, and graph pump enable prove source operation before heat-pump, boiler, or chiller commands are issued. CDL detects heat-pump and backup source-stage changes, then holds both sampled water resets until measured flow and the selected stage remain stable for 900 seconds. Sampled reset values set remote hot/chilled differential-pressure targets; editable CDL PI loops use measured pressure to command pump speed. Editable CDL diagnoses each pump when speed is commanded but physical motor proof stays absent for five minutes; these are diagnostic levels and do not alter source commands. Editable CDL diagnoses a running pump with no measured water flow after five minutes; the diagnostic does not command the sources. Raw equipment-availability inputs gate heat-pump capacity and backup source commands in CDL. Sampled water-reset holds now require raw source running status as well as water-flow proof. An editable timed CDL fault latch removes heat-pump capacity after a failed start; operator reset permits another attempt. An editable timed CDL fault latch inhibits boiler after a failed start until operator reset. An editable timed CDL fault latch inhibits chiller after a failed start until operator reset. Terminal hot-water reset requests now follow OBC discharge-temperature and valve tiers. Separate valve-based plant requests enable the hot-water loop. AHU plant requests now use separate OBC 95% start / 10% clear coil-valve latches; temperature reset tiers remain distinct.

blocks.notes: Use the larger of airflow feedforward and duct-pressure PI fan commands.

blocks.name: fan_request_threshold
blocks.notes: Keep the fan off when the AHU has no airflow request.

blocks.name: fan_requested
blocks.notes: Enable the fan when requested airflow exceeds the off threshold.

blocks.name: fan_off
blocks.notes: Zero fan speed when no VAV requests air.

blocks.name: fan_enable
blocks.notes: Gate the fan command with actual VAV airflow demand.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_pi
blocks.notes: OBC common-damper PI compares design-normalized outdoor airflow with its minimum and resets on rising physical fan proof.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_command
blocks.notes: Apply the greater of economizer and minimum outside-air flow commands.

blocks.name: economizer_mixed_air_pi
blocks.notes: Modulate outside-air fraction from measured mixed-air temperature and the supply-air target while economizing. Reset to a closed economizer command whenever CDL enables free cooling.

blocks.name: economizer_low_limit
blocks.notes: Conservative low-temperature guard for this simplified mixed-air model; not a G36 freeze-protection sequence.

blocks.name: outdoor_below_return
blocks.notes: Outdoor air can cool the return air.

blocks.name: return_above_supply_target
blocks.notes: The AHU calls for cooling relative to return air.

blocks.name: outdoor_above_low_limit
blocks.notes: Avoid low-temperature economizer operation.

blocks.name: free_cooling_useful
blocks.notes: Temperature conditions allow free cooling.

blocks.name: economizer_temperature_ok
blocks.notes: Outdoor air stays above the low limit while the fan is requested.

blocks.name: economizer_enabled
blocks.notes: Enable mixed-air temperature modulation when all conditions hold.

blocks.name: outdoor_air_select
blocks.notes: Select the modulating economizer fraction while enabled.

blocks.name: sat_request_sum_1
blocks.notes: Sum VAV cooling reset requests.

blocks.name: sat_request_sum_2
blocks.notes: Sum VAV cooling reset requests.

blocks.name: sat_request_sum_3
blocks.notes: Sum VAV cooling reset requests.

blocks.name: sat_request_sum_4
blocks.notes: Sum VAV cooling reset requests.

blocks.name: sat_request_real
blocks.notes: Convert the VAV request count for sampled reset arithmetic.

blocks.name: sat_ignored_requests
blocks.notes: Ignore the first two zone requests.

blocks.name: sat_excess_requests
blocks.notes: Requests above the ignored count.

blocks.name: sat_zero_requests
blocks.notes: Lower bound for excess requests.

blocks.name: sat_positive_requests
blocks.notes: Only respond to requests above the ignored count.

blocks.name: sat_response_gain
blocks.notes: Lower the supply target by 0.2 K per excess request each sample.

blocks.name: sat_max_response
blocks.notes: Cap each sample's cooling response at 0.6 K.

blocks.name: sat_bounded_response
blocks.notes: Limit the negative temperature response.

blocks.name: sat_trim
blocks.notes: Warm the target by 0.1 K each sample without enough requests.

blocks.name: sat_delta
blocks.notes: Combine the warm trim and cool response.

blocks.name: sat_previous
blocks.notes: Hold the previous two-minute supply-air temperature target.

blocks.name: sat_target_sum
blocks.notes: Apply the sampled reset to the previous supply target.

blocks.name: sat_minimum
blocks.notes: OBC lowest cooling supply target and the high-outdoor end of the reset line.

blocks.name: sat_above_minimum
blocks.notes: Do not cool the supply target below 14 °C.

blocks.name: sat_below_weather_max
blocks.notes: Clamp the sampled cooling maximum at the editable upper setpoint.

blocks.name: sat_fan_delay
blocks.notes: Delay trim and respond until 600 seconds plus one 120-second sample after physical fan proof.

blocks.name: sat_candidate
blocks.notes: Hold the maximum until fan proof and startup delay, then use sampled trim and respond.

blocks.name: sat_output
blocks.notes: Expose the current maximum cooling supply target, or its initial value while fan proof is absent.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_on
blocks.notes: Stage 1 begins after supply air stays below 4.4 °C for five minutes.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_off
blocks.notes: Stage 1 clears after supply air stays above 7 °C for five minutes.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_cold
blocks.notes: Detect low measured supply-air temperature.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_warm
blocks.notes: Detect recovered measured supply-air temperature.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_on_delay
blocks.notes: Require five continuous minutes below the Stage 1 temperature threshold.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_off_delay
blocks.notes: Require five continuous minutes above the recovery threshold.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_latch
blocks.notes: Hold Stage 1 during the supply-temperature recovery interval.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_outdoor_air
blocks.notes: Override the outdoor-air command to its editable minimum while Stage 1 is active.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_heating_enable
blocks.notes: Keep the heating coil enabled during Stage 1 even if normal mixed-air logic would disable it.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_request_integer
blocks.notes: Convert Stage 1 status into a hot-water plant request.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_one_two_requests
blocks.notes: Issue two hot-water plant requests during Stage 1.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_on
blocks.notes: Stage 2 begins after supply air stays below 3.3 °C for five minutes.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_cold
blocks.notes: Detect the deeper measured supply-air temperature fault.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_on_delay
blocks.notes: Require five continuous minutes below the Stage 2 temperature threshold.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_latch
blocks.notes: Hold the outdoor-air interruption until its one-hour timer has elapsed.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_to_integer
blocks.notes: Convert Stage 2 status for a sampled timer feedback path.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_to_real
blocks.notes: Convert the sampled Stage 2 status to a Real signal for the duration comparison.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_previous
blocks.notes: Break the Stage 2 latch/timer feedback loop using its prior sampled status.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_zero
blocks.notes: Zero means the prior Stage 2 state was inactive.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_previous_active
blocks.notes: Was Stage 2 active at the prior sample?

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_hour
blocks.notes: Clear Stage 2 after one hour including the sampled feedback and timer step.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_closed
blocks.notes: Close all outdoor-air paths while minimum ventilation is interrupted.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_outdoor_air
blocks.notes: Close outdoor air during Stage 2; otherwise restore Stage 1 or normal control.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_alarm_integer
blocks.notes: Convert the active ventilation interruption to alarm level one.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_alarm_double
blocks.notes: Build Level 2 from the active Stage 2 alarm bit.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_two_alarm_three
blocks.notes: Report Level 3 while minimum ventilation is interrupted.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_fifteen_threshold
blocks.notes: A supply temperature below 3.3 °C for 15 minutes requires shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_five_threshold
blocks.notes: A supply temperature below 1 °C for five minutes requires shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_below_fifteen
blocks.notes: Detect the sustained 3.3 °C shutdown fault.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_below_five
blocks.notes: Detect the deeper 1 °C shutdown fault.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_fifteen_delay
blocks.notes: Require 15 continuous minutes below 3.3 °C.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_five_delay
blocks.notes: Require five continuous minutes below 1 °C.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_sensor_fault
blocks.notes: Either sustained low-temperature condition requires shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_trip
blocks.notes: A freeze-stat trip or low-temperature fault requires shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_reset_temperature
blocks.notes: Permit operator reset only after supply air has recovered above 7 °C.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_reset_warm
blocks.notes: Supply air is warm enough to reset.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_stat_normal
blocks.notes: A freeze-stat trip must clear before operator reset.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_reset_safe
blocks.notes: Both supply temperature and freeze-stat status permit reset.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_reset_allowed
blocks.notes: Accept an operator reset only when the fault has cleared.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_latch
blocks.notes: Hold freeze shutdown until a safe operator reset; the harness cannot clear it.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_fan_off
blocks.notes: Stop the supply fan during shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_fan
blocks.notes: Override the graph fan command to zero.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_outdoor_closed
blocks.notes: Close outdoor air during shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_outdoor_air
blocks.notes: Override Stage 2 and normal outdoor-air commands.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_cooling_open
blocks.notes: Open the cooling-coil valve fully for coil freeze protection.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_cooling_valve
blocks.notes: Override the cooling-coil valve fully open during shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_measured_high
blocks.notes: Protect the warmer of measured supply and mixed air temperatures.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_heating_target
blocks.notes: Target 27 °C for the higher of measured supply and mixed air during shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_heating_pi
blocks.notes: Modulate the heating coil to protect the higher measured air temperature.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_heating_valve
blocks.notes: Use the shutdown heating PI while Stage 3 is latched.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_hot_request
blocks.notes: Stages 1 and 3 both issue two hot-water plant requests.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_alarm_two
blocks.notes: Level 2 alarm for a latched freeze shutdown.

blocks.name: freeze_stage_three_alarm_select
blocks.notes: The Stage 3 Level 2 shutdown alarm takes priority over the Stage 2 ventilation alarm.

blocks.name: economizer_high_limit_error
blocks.notes: Outdoor temperature minus return temperature for differential dry-bulb high limit.

blocks.name: economizer_high_limit_hysteresis
blocks.notes: Disable free cooling when outdoor reaches return temperature; re-enable below return by 1 K.

blocks.name: economizer_high_limit_ok
blocks.notes: Free cooling is available below the differential dry-bulb high limit.

blocks.name: economizer_freeze_early
blocks.notes: Either Stage 1 or Stage 2 freeze protection disables free cooling.

blocks.name: economizer_freeze_any
blocks.notes: Any of the three freeze stages disables free cooling.

blocks.name: economizer_freeze_clear
blocks.notes: Permit economizer control only with no freeze protection active.

blocks.name: economizer_proven_and_clear
blocks.notes: Require physical fan proof and no freeze stage.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_mode_enabled
blocks.notes: Enable minimum outdoor-air flow control only in occupied mode with proven fan airflow.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_off_setpoint
blocks.notes: No minimum outdoor airflow is required outside occupied mode or without fan proof.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_setpoint
blocks.notes: Gate the teaching outdoor-airflow setpoint by occupied mode and fan proof.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_off_command
blocks.notes: Disable the minimum outdoor-air PI command when its loop is inactive.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_active
blocks.notes: Use measured-flow minimum damper position only while the loop is enabled.

blocks.name: outdoor_air_fan_off
blocks.notes: Close normal outdoor air when the fan is not requested; freeze stages retain priority.

blocks.name: outdoor_air_fan_requested
blocks.notes: Allow normal outside air when the fan is requested, including cooldown and preconditioning.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_physical_max
blocks.notes: Editable mechanical maximum travel of the common outdoor-air damper.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_physical_limit
blocks.notes: Bound the final outdoor damper command by its physical maximum.

blocks.name: return_damper_one
blocks.notes: Fully open return damper reference.

blocks.name: return_damper_complement
blocks.notes: Normal return command complements the outdoor damper command.

blocks.name: return_damper_pi_midpoint
blocks.notes: Minimum-OA PI midpoint before return damper begins closing.

blocks.name: return_damper_pi_excess
blocks.notes: Minimum-OA PI demand above its midpoint.

blocks.name: return_damper_zero
blocks.notes: Lower return-damper limit.

blocks.name: return_damper_positive_excess
blocks.notes: Ignore PI demand below the return-damper closing range.

blocks.name: return_damper_double_excess
blocks.notes: Map the upper half of PI output over the full return damper stroke.

blocks.name: return_damper_pi_max
blocks.notes: Maximum return opening allowed by minimum outdoor airflow control.

blocks.name: return_damper_oa_limited
blocks.notes: Outdoor-air minimum can independently close the return damper.

blocks.name: return_damper_mode
blocks.notes: Apply the minimum-OA return limit only with occupied mode and proven fan.

blocks.name: return_damper_physical_max
blocks.notes: Editable mechanical maximum travel of the common return damper.

blocks.name: return_damper_physical_limit
blocks.notes: Bound the return damper command by its physical maximum.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_lower_half
blocks.notes: Clip the minimum outdoor-air PI output at the return-damper transition midpoint.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_outdoor_stroke
blocks.notes: Map PI output 0–0.5 to outdoor damper minimum position 0–1; above 0.5 the return damper closes instead.

blocks.name: vent_area_sum_1
blocks.notes: Sum vent area across the AHU zones.

blocks.name: vent_area_sum_2
blocks.notes: Sum vent area across the AHU zones.

blocks.name: vent_area_sum_3
blocks.notes: Sum vent area across the AHU zones.

blocks.name: vent_area_sum_4
blocks.notes: Sum vent area across the AHU zones.

blocks.notes: Sum vent primary across the AHU zones.

blocks.notes: Sum vent primary across the AHU zones.

blocks.name: vent_primary_sum_4
blocks.notes: Sum vent primary across the AHU zones.

blocks.name: zone_01_vent_primary_safe
blocks.notes: Bound primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: zone_01_vent_flow_bounded

blocks.name: zone_01_vent_fraction

blocks.name: zone_02_vent_epsilon

blocks.name: zone_02_vent_primary_safe
blocks.notes: Bound primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: zone_02_vent_flow_bounded
blocks.notes: Zone outdoor air cannot exceed measured primary flow.

blocks.name: zone_02_vent_fraction
blocks.notes: Zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.notes: Avoid zero primary-flow denominator.

blocks.notes: Bound primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: zone_03_vent_flow_bounded
blocks.notes: Zone outdoor air cannot exceed measured primary flow.

blocks.name: zone_03_vent_fraction
blocks.notes: Zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.notes: Avoid zero primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: zone_04_vent_primary_safe
blocks.notes: Bound primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: zone_04_vent_flow_bounded
blocks.notes: Zone outdoor air cannot exceed measured primary flow.

blocks.name: zone_04_vent_fraction
blocks.notes: Zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.name: zone_05_vent_epsilon
blocks.notes: Avoid zero primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: zone_05_vent_primary_safe
blocks.notes: Bound primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: zone_05_vent_flow_bounded
blocks.notes: Zone outdoor air cannot exceed measured primary flow.

blocks.name: zone_05_vent_fraction
blocks.notes: Zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.name: vent_fraction_max_1
blocks.notes: Maximum occupied-zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.name: vent_fraction_max_2
blocks.notes: Maximum occupied-zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.name: vent_fraction_max_3
blocks.notes: Maximum occupied-zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.name: vent_fraction_max_4
blocks.notes: Maximum occupied-zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.name: vent_breathing_total
blocks.notes: Sum adjusted area and population ventilation.

blocks.name: vent_uncorrected_design
blocks.notes: Editable design uncorrected minimum outside-air flow for five zones.

blocks.name: vent_uncorrected_limit
blocks.notes: Cap uncorrected airflow by design.

blocks.name: vent_primary_epsilon
blocks.notes: Avoid zero system primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: vent_primary_safe
blocks.notes: Bound system primary-flow denominator.

blocks.name: vent_uncorrected_fraction
blocks.notes: Uncorrected outdoor air divided by measured primary air.

blocks.name: vent_one
blocks.notes: Reference ventilation efficiency of one.

blocks.name: vent_efficiency_base
blocks.notes: One plus the uncorrected system outside-air fraction.

blocks.name: vent_efficiency
blocks.notes: Subtract the maximum zone outside-air fraction.

blocks.name: vent_efficiency_epsilon
blocks.notes: Lower numerical bound for system ventilation efficiency.

blocks.name: vent_efficiency_safe
blocks.notes: Avoid division by zero at low ventilation efficiency.

blocks.name: vent_effective_flow
blocks.notes: Correct uncorrected outdoor air for system ventilation efficiency.

blocks.name: vent_total_design
blocks.notes: Editable design total outside-air flow cap.

blocks.name: vent_effective_limit
blocks.notes: Cap effective outside-air flow by design.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_design_flow
blocks.notes: Editable design minimum outdoor-airflow rate used to normalize both PI inputs.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_design_floor
blocks.notes: Prevent a zero normalization denominator when design flow is edited.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_design_safe
blocks.notes: Use at least the numerical floor for outdoor-airflow normalization.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_setpoint_normalized
blocks.notes: Normalize effective minimum outdoor-airflow setpoint by design minimum flow.

blocks.name: minimum_oa_measured_normalized
blocks.notes: Normalize measured outdoor airflow by design minimum flow.

blocks.name: sat_mode_above_cooldown
blocks.notes: Codes above cooldown exclude the occupied cooling supply-air reset.

blocks.name: sat_mode_occupied_or_cooldown
blocks.notes: OBC modes 1 and 2 use the occupied cooling supply-air reset.

blocks.name: sat_mode_above_unoccupied
blocks.notes: Exclude the invalid mode 0 from the occupied reset.

blocks.name: sat_mode_weather_valid
blocks.notes: Use the outdoor-temperature and request reset in modes 1 and 2.

blocks.name: sat_mode_setup_code
blocks.notes: OBC setup mode is code 3.

blocks.name: sat_mode_is_setup
blocks.notes: Setup selects the low cooling supply target.

blocks.name: sat_mode_above_setup
blocks.notes: Warm-up and setback mode codes exceed setup.

blocks.name: sat_mode_above_setback
blocks.notes: Freeze protection and unoccupied codes exceed setback.

blocks.name: sat_mode_below_freeze
blocks.notes: Exclude freeze protection and unoccupied from the warm target.

blocks.name: sat_mode_heat_valid
blocks.notes: OBC modes 4 and 5 use the warm-up or setback target.

blocks.name: sat_mode_heating_permitted
blocks.notes: Permit normal heating-coil control only after supply fan proof; freeze stages override separately.

blocks.name: sat_mode_cooling_permitted
blocks.notes: Permit normal cooling-coil control only after supply fan proof; freeze Stage 3 overrides separately.

blocks.name: sat_mode_warm_target
blocks.notes: Editable warm-up and setback supply-air target.

blocks.name: sat_mode_off_target
blocks.notes: Deadband supply-air target while the fan is off or mode is inactive.

blocks.name: sat_mode_weather_select
blocks.notes: Use the sampled weather/request reset only in modes 1 and 2.

blocks.name: sat_mode_setup_select
blocks.notes: Use the editable minimum cooling target in setup mode.

blocks.name: sat_mode_heat_select
blocks.notes: Use 35 °C in warm-up and setback modes.

blocks.name: sat_mode_fan_select
blocks.notes: Use the deadband target unless the physical supply fan is proven on.

blocks.name: sat_maximum
blocks.notes: OBC highest cooling supply target and reset initial value.

blocks.name: sat_outdoor_low
blocks.notes: Lower OBC outdoor reset endpoint.

blocks.name: sat_outdoor_high
blocks.notes: Upper OBC outdoor reset endpoint.

blocks.name: sat_request_sample
blocks.notes: Sample the total VAV reset requests every two minutes, as in OBC TrimAndRespond.

blocks.name: sat_weather_line
blocks.notes: Interpolate from the sampled maximum at 16 °C outdoor to the minimum at 21 °C.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_command_threshold
blocks.notes: Treat a speed command above 1% as a fan-on command.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_commanded_on
blocks.notes: Classify the final supply fan command.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_status_off
blocks.notes: True when physical supply fan status is off.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_commanded_off
blocks.notes: True when CDL commands the supply fan off.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_failed_start
blocks.notes: Commanded on with physical status off.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_failed_stop
blocks.notes: Commanded off with physical status on.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_start_delay
blocks.notes: Require a 15-second on-command/status discrepancy before Level 2.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_stop_delay
blocks.notes: Require a 60-second off-command/status discrepancy before Level 4.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_clear
blocks.notes: No fan command/status discrepancy.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_level_two
blocks.notes: Level 2 fan commanded on but not running.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_level_four
blocks.notes: Level 4 fan running while commanded off.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_stop_select
blocks.notes: Expose the Level 4 failed-stop alarm.

blocks.name: fan_alarm_priority
blocks.notes: Level 2 failed-start alarm takes priority.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_error
blocks.notes: Final CDL fan speed command minus measured drive speed.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_tolerance
blocks.notes: Allow 15 percentage points of drive speed tracking error.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_low
blocks.notes: Physical drive speed trails the CDL command.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_min_command
blocks.notes: Diagnose speed tracking only when the fan is commanded above 40%.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_enabled
blocks.notes: Fan speed command is large enough to diagnose tracking.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_active
blocks.notes: Fan is proven on and the command exceeds the diagnostic minimum.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_condition
blocks.notes: Measured speed remains below the command while the fan runs.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_delay
blocks.notes: Require five continuous minutes of physical speed deficit.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_clear
blocks.notes: No supply-fan speed tracking alarm.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_level_three
blocks.notes: Teaching Level 3 drive speed tracking alarm.

blocks.name: fan_speed_tracking_select
blocks.notes: Publish the speed tracking alarm from the timed CDL condition.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_high_error
blocks.notes: Commanded opening minus measured opening.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_low_error
blocks.notes: Measured opening minus commanded opening.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_absolute_error
blocks.notes: Absolute command/position difference.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_tolerance
blocks.notes: Teaching alarm threshold: 25 percentage points of position error.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_error_high
blocks.notes: Position error exceeds the editable threshold.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_condition
blocks.notes: AHU fan is proven on while damper position fails to follow command.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_delay
blocks.notes: Require ten continuous minutes of physical position mismatch.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_clear
blocks.notes: No damper tracking alarm.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_level_three
blocks.notes: Teaching Level 3 damper position tracking alarm.

blocks.name: outdoor_damper_tracking_select
blocks.notes: Publish alarm level from the timed CDL condition.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_high_error
blocks.notes: Commanded opening minus measured opening.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_low_error
blocks.notes: Measured opening minus commanded opening.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_absolute_error
blocks.notes: Absolute command/position difference.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_tolerance
blocks.notes: Teaching alarm threshold: 25 percentage points of position error.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_error_high
blocks.notes: Position error exceeds the editable threshold.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_condition
blocks.notes: AHU fan is proven on while damper position fails to follow command.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_delay
blocks.notes: Require ten continuous minutes of physical position mismatch.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_clear
blocks.notes: No damper tracking alarm.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_level_three
blocks.notes: Teaching Level 3 damper position tracking alarm.

blocks.name: return_damper_tracking_select
blocks.notes: Publish alarm level from the timed CDL condition.

blocks.name: economizer_high_limit_hold
blocks.notes: Hold high-limit disabled and enabled states for at least ten minutes after a transition. Fan loss and freeze protection bypass this hold for immediate shutdown.

blocks.name: economizer_fixed_dry_bulb_cutoff
blocks.notes: Editable fixed outdoor dry-bulb high limit for climates using this device.

blocks.name: economizer_fixed_dry_bulb_error
blocks.notes: Outdoor temperature minus the fixed high-limit cutoff.

blocks.name: economizer_fixed_dry_bulb_hysteresis
blocks.notes: Disable at the fixed cutoff; re-enable one kelvin below it.

blocks.name: economizer_use_fixed_dry_bulb
blocks.notes: Set true to select the fixed dry-bulb high-limit device; false uses differential dry bulb.

blocks.name: economizer_dry_bulb_high_limit_select
blocks.notes: Choose the editable fixed or differential high-limit state before the ten-minute hold.

blocks.name: economizer_use_combined_dry_bulb
blocks.notes: Select the combined fixed and differential dry-bulb device. Keep false for the existing device choice.

blocks.name: economizer_combined_dry_bulb_trip
blocks.notes: Trip the combined high limit when either fixed or differential limit is exceeded.

blocks.name: economizer_dry_bulb_device_select
blocks.notes: Choose the combined device or the existing fixed/differential dry-bulb choice before the hold.

blocks.name: economizer_use_teaching_low_limit
blocks.notes: Optional teaching low-temperature guard. False uses the high-limit and freeze sequence without this extra cutoff.

blocks.name: economizer_low_limit_bypass
blocks.notes: Permit free cooling below the optional teaching cutoff while safety gates remain active.

blocks.name: economizer_low_limit_select
blocks.notes: Choose the editable teaching cutoff or bypass it before fan and freeze qualification.

blocks.name: economizer_use_teaching_demand_gate
blocks.notes: Optional teaching gate requiring return air above the supply target. Off follows the high-limit, fan-proof, and freeze enable conditions.

blocks.name: economizer_demand_gate_bypass
blocks.notes: Permit the economizer when its high limit, fan, and freeze conditions allow it; the PI still selects the actual outdoor command.

blocks.name: economizer_demand_gate_select
blocks.notes: Select the former return-above-supply teaching gate or bypass it in the economizer enable path.

blocks.name: economizer_disable
blocks.notes: Raw economizer-disable request after high-limit, fan-proof, and freeze checks.

Serves five VAV zones. Outdoor temperature chooses the supply-air target. Measured mixed and supply temperatures drive editable heating and cooling coil valve loops; total airflow request sets fan speed. An editable mixed-air PI loop modulates outdoor air when temperature conditions permit free cooling; minimum outside-air flow has priority. VAV cooling requests reset the sampled supply-air target within its outdoor-temperature bound. A timed Stage 1 freeze response reduces outdoor air to its minimum and sends two hot-water requests. Stage 2 closes outdoor air for one hour and reports a Level 3 ventilation alarm. Stage 3 latches fan shutdown, outdoor-air closure, full cooling-coil opening, and heating protection until a safe operator reset. Differential dry-bulb hysteresis, raw fan proof, and all freeze stages qualify economizer operation. Occupied mode and fan proof gate the measured-flow minimum; fan request permits normal economizer air in cooldown and preconditioning. An editable mechanical maximum limits final outdoor-damper travel. The return damper has an independent command and mechanical maximum. Its minimum-OA limit closes return air as PI demand rises above 0.5. The mixer derives outside-air share from both actuator openings. The first half of minimum-OA PI output opens the outdoor damper from zero to full stroke; the second half limits return-damper opening. Editable zone area/population components, measured primary flow, zone outdoor fractions, and system ventilation efficiency determine the minimum outside-air setpoint. The common-damper PI now uses design-normalized airflow and resets its output when physical fan proof rises. Editable OBC mode selection now sets occupied/cooldown, setup, warm-up/setback, and fan-off supply targets. The cooling maximum is sampled independently of outdoor weather; a CDL Line resets it over 16–21 °C. Typed 0–3 VAV requests enter the existing sampled SAT trim-and-respond sum. Supply fan command/status alarms use editable 15-second start and 60-second stop delays. Measured fan speed feeds an editable five-minute drive speed tracking diagnostic. Physical outdoor and return damper position sensors feed editable CDL tracking alarms. A CDL ten-minute high-limit state hold reduces economizer mode cycling; fan and freeze safety gates remain immediate. A CDL switch selects fixed or differential dry-bulb economizer high limit. An editable CDL switch also offers the combined fixed and differential dry-bulb high-limit device. The former 12 °C teaching low-temperature guard is optional CDL and is off by default; freeze protection still applies. A selectable teaching gate can require return air above supply target; it is bypassed by default. CDL delays outdoor-air closure 15 seconds and holds the return damper fully open 180 seconds after economizer disable.

Serves five VAV zones. Outdoor temperature chooses the supply-air target. Measured mixed and supply temperatures drive editable heating and cooling coil valve loops; total airflow request sets fan speed. An editable mixed-air PI loop modulates outdoor air when temperature conditions permit free cooling; minimum outside-air flow has priority. VAV cooling requests reset the sampled supply-air target within its outdoor-temperature bound. A timed Stage 1 freeze response reduces outdoor air to its minimum and sends two hot-water requests. Stage 2 closes outdoor air for one hour and reports a Level 3 ventilation alarm. Stage 3 latches fan shutdown, outdoor-air closure, full cooling-coil opening, and heating protection until a safe operator reset. Differential dry-bulb hysteresis, raw fan proof, and all freeze stages qualify economizer operation. Occupied mode and fan proof gate the measured-flow minimum; fan request permits normal economizer air in cooldown and preconditioning. An editable mechanical maximum limits final outdoor-damper travel. The return damper has an independent command and mechanical maximum. Its minimum-OA limit closes return air as PI demand rises above 0.5. The mixer derives outside-air share from both actuator openings. The first half of minimum-OA PI output opens the outdoor damper from zero to full stroke; the second half limits return-damper opening. Editable zone area/population components, measured primary flow, zone outdoor fractions, and system ventilation efficiency determine the minimum outside-air setpoint. The common-damper PI now uses design-normalized airflow and resets its output when physical fan proof rises. Editable OBC mode selection now sets occupied/cooldown, setup, warm-up/setback, and fan-off supply targets. The cooling maximum is sampled independently of outdoor weather; a CDL Line resets it over 16–21 °C. Typed 0–3 VAV requests enter the existing sampled SAT trim-and-respond sum. Supply fan command/status alarms use editable 15-second start and 60-second stop delays. Measured fan speed feeds an editable five-minute drive speed tracking diagnostic. Physical outdoor and return damper position sensors feed editable CDL tracking alarms. A CDL ten-minute high-limit state hold reduces economizer mode cycling; fan and freeze safety gates remain immediate. A CDL switch selects fixed or differential dry-bulb economizer high limit. An editable CDL switch also offers the combined fixed and differential dry-bulb high-limit device. The former 12 °C teaching low-temperature guard is optional CDL and is off by default; freeze protection still applies. A selectable teaching gate can require return air above supply target; it is bypassed by default. CDL delays outdoor-air closure 15 seconds and holds the return damper fully open 180 seconds after economizer disable.

The scheduled mode uses occupied 21/24 °C setpoints. Five minutes without a person widens both setpoints by 0.5 K and reduces ventilation minimums; one minute of presence restores them. Outside the occupied schedule, shared group setback and setup modes enable editable 18/32 °C targets; otherwise heating and cooling are off and ventilation minimum is zero. Before occupancy, warm-up or cooldown restores occupied temperature setpoints but keeps the reduced ventilation minimum. Heating mode raises airflow above minimum only after the discharge is warm, while preconditioning can use the heating maximum. CDL TrueDelay and Latch blocks confirm arrival and vacancy from the raw occupancy sensor. Measured airflow and discharge temperature are fed back from the physical model. A CDL discharge-temperature reset and valve PI loop command reheat, and five-minute low-flow and high-discharge alarms report persistent faults. Heating demand resets the discharge target; a PI loop uses measured discharge temperature to command reheat. Heating airflow rises only after the discharge is 3 K warmer than the room. The damper PI tracks measured primary airflow; its setpoint remains separate from the physical delivery. Editable floor area and breathing-air rates combine with measured occupant count. Occupied presence gates area and population ventilation; measured discharge selects heating or cooling distribution effectiveness. Measured CO₂ resets occupied minimum primary airflow through editable CDL; the physical model only supplies concentration. A cooling call can open its damper while supply air is warm during AHU startup; a warm supply is diagnosed at the AHU rather than suppressing the request. The local CDL mode distinguishes occupied, sensor standby, warm-up, cooldown, setup, setback, and unoccupied conditions; these teaching codes are not the G36 zone-group enumeration. Group warm-up and cooldown now come from the five-zone CDL coordinator; occupied setpoint edits feed its sampled optimal-start estimate. Unoccupied heating/cooling is commanded by the shared CDL group setback/setup/freeze decisions. Open windows disable ordinary terminal heating and cooling; group freeze setback retains heating. A timed local occupancy override selects occupied terminal mode and makes its AHU group occupied through CDL. Editable occupied-mode low-flow diagnosis waits for 30 minutes of AHU fan proof, then raises Level 3 below 70% or Level 2 below 50% of requested primary airflow after five minutes. High-discharge temperature diagnosis requires local occupied mode and AHU fan proof throughout its five-minute delay. Duct-pressure reset samples damper, setpoint, and measured flow together every 120 seconds; one minute of damper request qualifies the 2/3 levels. A zero importance suppresses requests and low-airflow alarms. Cooling SAT reset sends editable 0–3 requests from zone error and the normalized cooling PI loop; higher tiers wait through setpoint-change suppression. SAT request suppression now follows the editable 540 s/K captured-error calculation, capped at 1800 s. Pinned OBC SystemRequests hot-water tiers issue 3/2 after five minutes more than 17/8 K below the discharge target, or 1 while the reheat valve is above 95% (clear below 85%). A separate plant request holds until the valve falls below 10%. A Level 3 airflow-sensor calibration alarm reports residual measured flow above ten percent of design after ten minutes of AHU fan-off proof. Low-discharge error timers run on measured temperature; occupied mode, physical fan and heating-source proof, and editable reset importance gate the published Level 3/2 alarms. Editable Level 4 leakage alarms use fan status, closed damper command plus measured flow, and closed measured valve plus discharge temperature rise. An editable occupied-standby policy retains area ventilation and base primary minimum during vacancy where standby is disallowed; population air still follows confirmed presence. OBC integer airflow override codes 1–4 select zero, nominal cooling maximum, design minimum, or nominal heating maximum before damper feedback. Normal primary airflow setpoint follows editable OBC cooling, deadband, and heating mapping independently of damper command.

blocks.name: high_discharge_detected
blocks.notes: Measured discharge temperature exceeds the editable upper target.

blocks.name: high_discharge_delay
blocks.notes: Require five continuous minutes above the discharge upper target before alarm.

blocks.name: high_discharge_alarm_priority
blocks.notes: Teaching priority for persistent high discharge: 3 while active, 0 when clear. This level is not yet reference-verified.

blocks.name: standby_cool
blocks.notes: Occupied standby cooling setpoint after five minutes vacant.

blocks.name: standby_heat
blocks.notes: Occupied standby heating setpoint after five minutes vacant.

blocks.name: unoccupied_cool
blocks.notes: G36 unoccupied cooling setback setpoint.

blocks.name: unoccupied_heat
blocks.notes: Editable unoccupied heating setback; the three-hour optimal-start cap can recover from this teaching target.

blocks.name: standby_damper
blocks.notes: No occupied-standby ventilation minimum while the zone is vacant.

blocks.name: unoccupied_damper
blocks.notes: No ventilation minimum outside occupied schedule.

blocks.name: standby_airflow
blocks.notes: No occupied-standby airflow minimum while the zone is vacant.

blocks.name: unoccupied_airflow
blocks.notes: No minimum airflow outside occupied schedule.

blocks.name: presence_delay
blocks.notes: Require one continuous minute of presence before setting occupied.

blocks.name: presence_inverse
blocks.notes: True when the raw occupancy sensor reports vacant.

blocks.name: vacancy_delay
blocks.notes: Require five continuous minutes vacant before clearing occupied.

blocks.name: occupancy_latch
blocks.notes: Hold confirmed occupancy until the vacancy delay clears it.

blocks.name: conditioning_mode
blocks.notes: Request occupied temperature setpoints during the schedule or the preconditioning window.

blocks.name: cool_setpoint_standby
blocks.notes: Select occupied or sensor-vacant standby value.

blocks.name: cool_setpoint_active
blocks.notes: Select scheduled or unoccupied value.

blocks.name: heat_setpoint_standby
blocks.notes: Select occupied or sensor-vacant standby value.

blocks.name: heat_setpoint_active
blocks.notes: Select scheduled or unoccupied value.

blocks.name: minimum_damper_standby
blocks.notes: Select occupied or sensor-vacant standby value.

blocks.name: minimum_damper_active
blocks.notes: Select scheduled or unoccupied value.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow_standby
blocks.notes: Select occupied or sensor-vacant standby value.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow_active
blocks.notes: Select scheduled or unoccupied value.

blocks.name: minimum_damper_heating
blocks.notes: Preserve minimum discharge airflow during a heating call.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow_heating
blocks.notes: Preserve minimum discharge airflow during a heating call.

blocks.name: heating_damper_gain
blocks.notes: Increase primary-air damper opening as the heating PI demand rises.

blocks.name: heating_damper_offset
blocks.notes: Add heating demand to the zone's active minimum damper position.

blocks.name: heating_damper_limit
blocks.notes: Keep heating damper command within its physical travel.

blocks.name: heating_damper_select
blocks.notes: Use the heating airflow path during a heating call; otherwise retain the cooling/ventilation path.

blocks.name: discharge_max_rise
blocks.notes: Maximum heating discharge target above the active zone heating setpoint.

blocks.name: discharge_upper
blocks.notes: Active heating setpoint plus the editable maximum rise.

blocks.name: discharge_span
blocks.notes: Difference from AHU supply target to maximum heating discharge target.

blocks.name: discharge_zero_rise
blocks.notes: Do not request a negative reheat span.

blocks.name: discharge_positive_span
blocks.notes: Nonnegative discharge temperature rise available for heating.

blocks.name: discharge_demand_double
blocks.notes: Reach maximum discharge target at 50% heating-loop demand.

blocks.name: discharge_demand_limit
blocks.notes: Keep discharge reset fraction between zero and one.

blocks.name: discharge_reset_rise
blocks.notes: Scale available temperature rise by heating-loop demand.

blocks.name: discharge_reset_target
blocks.notes: Reset target from AHU supply temperature to active heating setpoint plus 11 K.

blocks.name: discharge_target_cap
blocks.notes: Apply the editable absolute discharge temperature upper bound.

blocks.name: discharge_minimum
blocks.notes: Minimum discharge temperature for the low-temperature reheat exception.

blocks.name: discharge_target
blocks.notes: Use heating reset target in heating mode; otherwise protect the 10 °C minimum.

blocks.name: discharge_valve_pi
blocks.notes: Reset the reheat PI to a closed valve on each heating or low-discharge enable; gain is tuned to the simplified 8 kW coil.

blocks.name: discharge_below_minimum
blocks.notes: OBC minimum-discharge threshold: assert below the editable minimum and clear 0.25 K above it.

blocks.name: discharge_minimum_occupied
blocks.notes: Apply the 10 °C minimum-discharge exception only in occupied mode.

blocks.name: discharge_valve_enable
blocks.notes: Enable reheat during a heating call or occupied low-discharge protection.

blocks.name: discharge_valve_closed
blocks.notes: Close reheat valve outside heating and low-temperature protection.

blocks.name: discharge_valve_select
blocks.notes: Gate the discharge-temperature PI valve command.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_midpoint
blocks.notes: The first half of heating demand resets discharge temperature, not airflow.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_excess
blocks.notes: Heating demand above the 50% discharge-reset stage.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_double
blocks.notes: Map the upper half of heating demand to the full heating airflow range.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_limit
blocks.notes: Keep the upper-stage heating airflow fraction in its valid range.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_margin
blocks.notes: Only increase heating flow when discharge exceeds room temperature by 3 K.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_threshold
blocks.notes: Room temperature plus the editable warm-discharge margin.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_warm
blocks.notes: Measured discharge air is warm enough to increase primary flow.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_enabled
blocks.notes: Only raise airflow in heating mode with warm discharge air.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_zero
blocks.notes: Hold heating airflow at its active minimum until the warm-discharge condition is met.

blocks.name: heating_airflow_select
blocks.notes: Apply the upper-stage heating airflow request only after discharge is warm.

blocks.name: heating_warmup_full
blocks.notes: Use the heating airflow maximum during preconditioning warm-up.

blocks.name: heating_warmup_airflow
blocks.notes: In preconditioning, use the heating maximum instead of the occupied-stage airflow request.

blocks.name: damper_flow_pi
blocks.notes: OBC-style PI tracks primary airflow and resets to 1% damper output when AHU fan proof rises.

blocks.name: damper_flow_threshold
blocks.notes: Close the damper when the airflow setpoint is effectively zero.

blocks.name: damper_flow_requested
blocks.notes: The terminal has a nonzero primary-airflow setpoint.

blocks.name: damper_closed
blocks.notes: Command a closed damper when primary airflow is not requested.

blocks.name: damper_feedback_output
blocks.notes: Use the measured-airflow PI command only while primary air is requested.

blocks.name: measured_airflow_passthrough
blocks.notes: Expose measured primary airflow separately from its commanded setpoint.

blocks.name: ventilation_occupied
blocks.notes: Ventilation applies only when the schedule and confirmed occupancy are both active.

blocks.name: ventilation_window_eligible
blocks.notes: An open window suppresses mechanical ventilation components for this zone.

blocks.name: ventilation_floor_area
blocks.notes: Synthetic design floor area served by this zone, in square metres.

blocks.name: ventilation_area_rate
blocks.notes: Editable ASHRAE 62.1 breathing-air design rate per square metre.

blocks.name: ventilation_area_design
blocks.notes: Design floor area times outdoor-air rate per area.

blocks.name: ventilation_person_rate
blocks.notes: Editable ASHRAE 62.1 breathing-air design rate per person.

blocks.name: ventilation_population_design
blocks.notes: Measured occupant count times outdoor-air rate per person.

blocks.name: ventilation_zero
blocks.notes: No breathing-zone air in unoccupied or standby mode.

blocks.name: ventilation_area_active
blocks.notes: Gate the area component by occupied presence.

blocks.name: ventilation_population_active
blocks.notes: Gate the population component by occupied presence.

blocks.name: ventilation_breathing_sum
blocks.notes: Sum the area and population components.

blocks.name: ventilation_cooling_supply
blocks.notes: Measured room air warmer than discharge air selects cooling distribution effectiveness with OBC hysteresis.

blocks.name: ventilation_cooling_effectiveness
blocks.notes: Cooling air-distribution effectiveness.

blocks.name: ventilation_heating_effectiveness
blocks.notes: Heating air-distribution effectiveness.

blocks.name: ventilation_effectiveness
blocks.notes: Select heating or cooling distribution effectiveness.

blocks.name: ventilation_minimum_oa
blocks.notes: Breathing-zone outdoor air divided by distribution effectiveness.

blocks.name: co2_reset_lower
blocks.notes: Start increasing occupied minimum airflow 200 ppm below the CO₂ setpoint.

blocks.name: co2_reset_span
blocks.notes: Editable CO₂ proportional reset span.

blocks.name: co2_above_lower
blocks.notes: Measured CO₂ above the reset start.

blocks.name: co2_reset_ratio
blocks.notes: Normalize the CO₂ error by the editable span.

blocks.name: co2_reset_limit
blocks.notes: Match the OBC CO₂ reset line from setpoint minus 200 ppm to setpoint.

blocks.name: co2_cooling_max_flow
blocks.notes: Teaching design cooling maximum for this VAV.

blocks.name: co2_available_flow
blocks.notes: Cooling maximum minus the current occupied minimum.

blocks.name: co2_flow_increment
blocks.notes: Scale available flow by CO₂ reset fraction.

blocks.name: co2_flow_reset
blocks.notes: Raise occupied minimum airflow toward cooling maximum.

blocks.name: co2_population_component
blocks.notes: Reset the measured-count population ventilation component from zero to design as CO₂ rises.

blocks.name: co2_minimum_flow
blocks.notes: Apply the CO₂ reset only with scheduled, confirmed occupancy.

blocks.name: window_primary_minimum
blocks.notes: Suppress the occupied primary-air minimum when the window contact is open; freeze heating remains a separate request.

blocks.name: warmup_error
blocks.notes: Occupied heating target minus measured room temperature.

blocks.name: cooldown_error
blocks.notes: Measured room temperature minus occupied cooling target.

blocks.name: setback_error
blocks.notes: Unoccupied heating target minus measured room temperature.

blocks.name: setup_error
blocks.notes: Measured room temperature minus unoccupied cooling target.

blocks.name: warmup_needed
blocks.notes: Editable temperature deadband prevents mode chatter near the target.

blocks.name: cooldown_needed
blocks.notes: Editable temperature deadband prevents mode chatter near the target.

blocks.name: setback_needed
blocks.notes: Editable temperature deadband prevents mode chatter near the target.

blocks.name: setup_needed
blocks.notes: Editable temperature deadband prevents mode chatter near the target.

blocks.name: warmup_mode
blocks.notes: Warm-up only inside the schedule lookahead window.

blocks.name: cooldown_mode
blocks.notes: Cooldown only inside the schedule lookahead window.

blocks.name: preconditioning_needed
blocks.notes: Restore occupied targets only when warm-up or cooldown is needed.

blocks.name: occupied_setpoint_requested
blocks.notes: Use occupied setpoints for confirmed presence or thermal preconditioning.

blocks.name: mode_unoccupied
blocks.notes: Local teaching mode code for unoccupied.

blocks.name: mode_occupied
blocks.notes: Local teaching mode code for occupied.

blocks.name: mode_standby
blocks.notes: Local teaching mode code for standby.

blocks.name: mode_warmup
blocks.notes: Local teaching mode code for warmup.

blocks.name: mode_cooldown
blocks.notes: Local teaching mode code for cooldown.

blocks.name: mode_setup
blocks.notes: Local teaching mode code for setup.

blocks.name: mode_setback
blocks.notes: Local teaching mode code for setback.

blocks.name: mode_select_setback
blocks.notes: Choose the setback mode from CDL conditions.

blocks.name: mode_select_setup
blocks.notes: Choose the setup mode from CDL conditions.

blocks.name: mode_select_cooldown
blocks.notes: Choose the cooldown mode from CDL conditions.

blocks.name: mode_select_warmup
blocks.notes: Choose the warmup mode from CDL conditions.

blocks.name: mode_select_occupied
blocks.notes: Choose the occupied mode from CDL conditions.

blocks.name: mode_select_schedule
blocks.notes: Choose the schedule mode from CDL conditions.

blocks.name: damper_is_unoccupied
blocks.notes: Identify local unoccupied mode before commanding the damper fully closed.

blocks.name: damper_operation_enabled
blocks.notes: Allow the measured-airflow PI to respond to a zero-flow override outside unoccupied mode.

blocks.name: unoccupied_heat_off
blocks.notes: Disable ordinary unoccupied heating outside group setback/freeze.

blocks.name: unoccupied_cool_off
blocks.notes: Disable ordinary unoccupied cooling outside group setup.

blocks.name: group_heat_allowed
blocks.notes: Permit unoccupied heat during group setback or freeze protection.

blocks.name: unoccupied_heat_enabled
blocks.notes: Select group setback target or off target.

blocks.name: unoccupied_cool_enabled
blocks.notes: Select group setup target or off target.

blocks.name: mode_freeze_setback
blocks.notes: Local teaching code 7 for group zone-freeze setback.

blocks.name: mode_select_freeze_setback
blocks.notes: Show group freeze setback before ordinary setback/setup.

blocks.name: window_heat_permit
blocks.notes: Freeze setback keeps heating available with a window open.

blocks.name: window_heat_target
blocks.notes: Disable ordinary heating while the window is open.

blocks.name: window_cool_target
blocks.notes: Disable cooling while the window is open.

blocks.name: local_occupied
blocks.notes: Scheduled occupancy or local override selects occupied zone control.

blocks.name: low_flow_fan_ready
blocks.notes: A fan newly proven on qualifies after 30 continuous minutes; an already-on fan at initialization qualifies immediately, following OBC TrueDelay.

blocks.name: low_flow_occupied_and_fan
blocks.notes: Only an occupied zone with proven AHU fan operation may raise a low-flow alarm.

blocks.name: low_flow_seventy_setpoint
blocks.notes: Level 3 fault threshold is 70% of the active primary-airflow setpoint.

blocks.name: low_flow_below_seventy
blocks.notes: Measured primary airflow is below 70% of setpoint.

blocks.name: low_flow_eligible
blocks.notes: Allow the moderate alarm only for an occupied zone with a nonzero airflow request.

blocks.name: low_flow_occupied_gate
blocks.notes: Apply occupied and pressure-importance eligibility after the severe flow timer.

blocks.name: low_flow_seventy_condition
blocks.notes: Fan-proven measured flow is below the Level 3 threshold.

blocks.name: low_flow_seventy_output_gate
blocks.notes: Apply occupied, request, and importance eligibility after the moderate flow timer.

blocks.name: low_flow_severe_request_gate
blocks.notes: Apply the separately timed nonzero-request gate after the severe flow timer.

blocks.name: low_flow_request_delay
blocks.notes: OBC waits five minutes after a newly nonzero airflow setpoint; an already nonzero setpoint qualifies at initialization.

blocks.name: low_flow_seventy_delay
blocks.notes: OBC TrueDelay alarms immediately when already below 70% at initialization; later deficits persist five minutes.

blocks.name: low_flow_alarm_zero
blocks.notes: No terminal low-airflow alarm.

blocks.name: low_flow_alarm_three
blocks.notes: Level 3 sustained low-airflow alarm.

blocks.name: low_flow_alarm_two
blocks.notes: Level 2 severe low-airflow alarm.

blocks.name: low_flow_alarm_moderate
blocks.notes: Show Level 3 after the 70% fault delay.

blocks.name: low_flow_alarm_priority
blocks.notes: Severe Level 2 fault takes precedence over Level 3.

blocks.name: high_discharge_eligible
blocks.notes: Only diagnose high discharge temperature while the zone is locally occupied and the AHU fan is proven.

blocks.name: high_discharge_condition
blocks.notes: Start the high-discharge timer only with valid fan and occupied proof.

blocks.name: pressure_importance
blocks.notes: Zero removes this zone from duct-pressure reset and suppresses its low-airflow alarm.

blocks.name: pressure_importance_zero
blocks.notes: Disabled-importance threshold.

blocks.name: pressure_importance_positive
blocks.notes: Only a positive pressure-reset importance enables requests and the related low-flow alarm.

blocks.name: pressure_damper_hysteresis
blocks.notes: OBC's shared damper latch starts above 95% and clears at or below 85%; it qualifies every request tier.

blocks.name: pressure_damper_sample
blocks.notes: Sample damper command at the same 120-second period as AHU pressure trim and respond.

blocks.name: pressure_setpoint_sample
blocks.notes: Sample active primary-airflow setpoint with the damper command.

blocks.name: pressure_measured_sample
blocks.notes: Sample measured primary airflow for the same pressure-request instant.

blocks.name: pressure_damper_delay
blocks.notes: OBC waits one minute after the sampled damper request, independently of changing airflow.

blocks.name: pressure_setpoint_positive
blocks.notes: OBC permits high-tier requests only when sampled setpoint exceeds 0.01, clearing below 0.005.

blocks.name: pressure_flow_half
blocks.notes: Severe request threshold is 50% of active airflow setpoint.

blocks.name: pressure_flow_seventy
blocks.notes: Moderate request threshold is 70% of active airflow setpoint.

blocks.name: pressure_below_half
blocks.notes: Measured primary airflow is below 50% of setpoint with 0.01 flow hysteresis.

blocks.name: pressure_below_seventy
blocks.notes: Measured primary airflow is below 70% of setpoint with 0.01 flow hysteresis.

blocks.name: pressure_damper_flow_eligible
blocks.notes: The sampled damper has requested pressure for one minute and airflow setpoint is positive.

blocks.name: pressure_severe_eligible
blocks.notes: The severe flow deficit has a nonzero setpoint.

blocks.name: pressure_moderate_eligible
blocks.notes: The moderate flow deficit has a nonzero setpoint.

blocks.name: pressure_level_0
blocks.notes: 0 duct-pressure reset requests.

blocks.name: pressure_level_1
blocks.notes: 1 duct-pressure reset requests.

blocks.name: pressure_level_2
blocks.notes: 2 duct-pressure reset requests.

blocks.name: pressure_level_3
blocks.notes: 3 duct-pressure reset requests.

blocks.name: pressure_one_request
blocks.notes: Send one request while the damper hysteresis is active.

blocks.name: pressure_two_requests
blocks.notes: Two requests take precedence after a sustained 70% flow deficit.

blocks.name: pressure_three_requests
blocks.notes: Three requests take precedence after a sustained 50% flow deficit.

blocks.name: pressure_importance_select
blocks.notes: A zero importance suppresses all pressure requests.

blocks.name: low_flow_importance_gate
blocks.notes: A zero pressure-reset importance suppresses both low-airflow alarm levels.

blocks.name: sat_cooling_error
blocks.notes: Zone temperature minus active cooling setpoint.

blocks.name: sat_two_error_high
blocks.notes: Cooling error exceeds 2 K, clearing below 1.75 K.

blocks.name: sat_three_error_high
blocks.notes: Cooling error exceeds 3 K, clearing below 2.75 K.

blocks.name: sat_two_error_delay
blocks.notes: Two continuous minutes above the hysteretic 2 K threshold.

blocks.name: sat_three_error_delay
blocks.notes: Two continuous minutes above the hysteretic 3 K threshold.

blocks.name: sat_cooling_loop_high
blocks.notes: One request starts above 95% of the cooling PI loop and holds until below 85%.

blocks.name: sat_cooling_loop_scale
blocks.notes: Normalize the existing cooling PI's 0–0.85 damper command to a 0–1 cooling-loop signal. Retune this gain if the PI output maximum changes.

blocks.name: sat_cooling_loop_limit
blocks.notes: Keep the normalized cooling loop within the OBC 0–1 input range.

blocks.name: sat_previous_cooling_setpoint
blocks.notes: Sample the active cooling setpoint every two minutes for change suppression.

blocks.name: sat_sampled_cooling_setpoint
blocks.notes: Sample the active cooling target every two minutes before detecting a material setpoint change, matching the OBC TimeSuppression input sampler.

blocks.name: sat_setpoint_rise
blocks.notes: Current setpoint minus previous sample.

blocks.name: sat_setpoint_fall
blocks.notes: Previous setpoint minus current sample.

blocks.name: sat_change_threshold
blocks.notes: Ignore setpoint changes of 0.25 K or less.

blocks.name: sat_setpoint_rise_detected
blocks.notes: Detect a material setpoint rise.

blocks.name: sat_setpoint_fall_detected
blocks.notes: Detect a material setpoint fall.

blocks.name: sat_setpoint_changed
blocks.notes: Either setpoint direction starts suppression.

blocks.name: sat_two_eligible
blocks.notes: Two requests require sustained error and completed suppression.

blocks.name: sat_three_eligible
blocks.notes: Three requests require sustained error and completed suppression.

blocks.name: sat_level_0
blocks.notes: 0 cooling supply-air temperature reset requests.

blocks.name: sat_level_1
blocks.notes: 1 cooling supply-air temperature reset requests.

blocks.name: sat_level_2
blocks.notes: 2 cooling supply-air temperature reset requests.

blocks.name: sat_level_3
blocks.notes: 3 cooling supply-air temperature reset requests.

blocks.name: sat_request_one
blocks.notes: One request while the cooling-loop proxy is high.

blocks.name: sat_request_two
blocks.notes: Two sustained-error requests take precedence.

blocks.name: sat_request_three
blocks.notes: Three sustained-error requests take precedence.

blocks.name: sat_startup_true
blocks.notes: Begin the first-sampling-period guard at initialization.

blocks.name: sat_startup_delay
blocks.notes: Ignore setpoint changes during the first 120 seconds, as in OBC TimeSuppression.

blocks.name: sat_change_after_startup
blocks.notes: Only a sampled setpoint change after startup resets suppression.

blocks.name: sat_change_latch
blocks.notes: Hold the first material setpoint change until its suppression interval expires.

blocks.name: sat_clear_to_real
blocks.notes: Carry the passed flag through a sampled state break.

blocks.name: sat_clear_previous
blocks.notes: Clear the suppression latch at the next 120-second sample.

blocks.name: sat_clear_boolean
blocks.notes: Convert the delayed passed flag back to Boolean.

blocks.name: sat_latch_inactive
blocks.notes: Requests are eligible whenever no setpoint-change interval is active.

blocks.name: sat_change_edge
blocks.notes: Capture the next material setpoint change once.

blocks.name: sat_change_setpoint
blocks.notes: setpoint at the setpoint change.

blocks.name: sat_change_room_temp
blocks.notes: room_temp at the setpoint change.

blocks.name: sat_change_error
blocks.notes: Setpoint minus room temperature when the change occurred.

blocks.name: sat_change_error_reverse
blocks.notes: Room temperature minus setpoint when the change occurred.

blocks.name: sat_change_error_abs
blocks.notes: Magnitude of the zone error when the setpoint changes.

blocks.name: sat_suppression_rate
blocks.notes: OBC request suppression: 540 seconds per Kelvin of zone error.

blocks.name: sat_suppression_maximum
blocks.notes: Cap request suppression at 30 minutes.

blocks.name: sat_suppression_duration
blocks.notes: Minimum of 540 s/K times captured zone error and 1800 seconds.

blocks.name: sat_suppression_timer
blocks.notes: Elapsed time while the first setpoint change remains latched.

blocks.name: sat_suppression_passed
blocks.notes: Release after elapsed time exceeds the calculated duration.

blocks.name: sat_suppression_complete
blocks.notes: Allow requests outside a latched change or once its suppression time has passed.

blocks.name: sensor_fan_off
blocks.notes: Diagnose the flow sensor only while the AHU fan motor is proven off.

blocks.name: sensor_fan_off_delay
blocks.notes: Require ten continuous minutes of fan-off proof before checking residual flow.

blocks.name: sensor_cooling_design_flow
blocks.notes: Editable design cooling maximum: 0.2 minimum plus 0.75 cooling span in this example.

blocks.name: sensor_ten_percent
blocks.notes: A reading above ten percent of design cooling flow indicates sensor calibration trouble while the fan is off.

blocks.name: sensor_residual_flow
blocks.notes: Measured primary flow exceeds ten percent of design cooling flow.

blocks.name: sensor_alarm_condition
blocks.notes: Fan proven off for ten minutes and measured flow remains above the design threshold.

blocks.name: sensor_alarm_zero
blocks.notes: No airflow sensor calibration alarm.

blocks.name: sensor_alarm_three
blocks.notes: Level 3 airflow sensor calibration alarm.

blocks.name: sensor_alarm_select
blocks.notes: Publish Level 3 only when the fan-off residual-flow condition is true.

blocks.name: low_discharge_importance
blocks.notes: Set to zero to suppress this zone's hot-water reset alarms.

blocks.name: low_discharge_zero_importance
blocks.notes: Alarm suppression threshold.

blocks.name: low_discharge_important
blocks.notes: Hot-water reset importance must be positive to allow alarms.

blocks.name: low_discharge_fan_and_plant
blocks.notes: The AHU supply fan and hot-water plant must both be physically proven.

blocks.name: low_discharge_occupied_and_plant
blocks.notes: The zone is occupied and the AHU fan and hot-water plant are proven.

blocks.name: low_discharge_eligible
blocks.notes: Suppress temperature alarms when hot-water reset importance is zero.

blocks.name: low_discharge_error
blocks.notes: Discharge setpoint minus measured discharge temperature.

blocks.name: low_discharge_level_three_threshold
blocks.notes: Level 3 when measured discharge is more than 8 K below setpoint.

blocks.name: low_discharge_level_two_threshold
blocks.notes: Level 2 when measured discharge is more than 17 K below setpoint.

blocks.name: low_discharge_below_eight
blocks.notes: Measured discharge more than 8 K below its CDL setpoint.

blocks.name: low_discharge_below_seventeen
blocks.notes: Measured discharge more than 17 K below its CDL setpoint.

blocks.name: low_discharge_three_condition
blocks.notes: Publish the timed Level 3 error only while occupied, important, and the hot-water plant is proven.

blocks.name: low_discharge_two_condition
blocks.notes: Publish the timed Level 2 error only while occupied, important, and the hot-water plant is proven.

blocks.name: low_discharge_three_delay
blocks.notes: Time the discharge temperature error independently of occupancy and plant proof, as in OBC Alarms.

blocks.name: low_discharge_two_delay
blocks.notes: Time the discharge temperature error independently of occupancy and plant proof, as in OBC Alarms.

blocks.name: low_discharge_level_zero
blocks.notes: No temperature alarm.

blocks.name: low_discharge_level_three
blocks.notes: Level 3 low discharge temperature alarm.

blocks.name: low_discharge_level_two
blocks.notes: Level 2 low discharge temperature alarm.

blocks.name: low_discharge_moderate
blocks.notes: Publish Level 3 after its ten-minute delay.

blocks.name: low_discharge_priority
blocks.notes: Severe Level 2 takes precedence over Level 3.

blocks.name: leak_damper_closed_limit
blocks.notes: Treat a damper command below 5% as closed, following the OBC default.

blocks.name: leak_damper_command_closed
blocks.notes: Terminal damper commanded closed by editable CDL.

blocks.name: leak_damper_closed_and_fan
blocks.notes: The damper is commanded closed while AHU fan status is proven on.

blocks.name: leak_damper_flow_high
blocks.notes: Measured flow exceeds ten percent of design cooling flow with 0.05 OBC clearing hysteresis.

blocks.name: leak_damper_condition
blocks.notes: A closed commanded damper still passes measurable air while the fan runs.

blocks.name: leak_damper_delay
blocks.notes: Require ten continuous minutes of closed-command flow before Level 4.

blocks.name: leak_valve_closed_limit
blocks.notes: Treat a measured valve position below 5% as closed, following the OBC default.

blocks.name: leak_valve_position_closed
blocks.notes: Measured reheat valve actuator is closed, even if its seat leaks water.

blocks.name: leak_valve_closed_delay
blocks.notes: Require fifteen continuous minutes of closed valve, fan proof, and warm discharge.

blocks.name: leak_valve_temperature_rise
blocks.notes: Measured VAV discharge minus measured AHU supply temperature.

blocks.name: leak_valve_rise_threshold
blocks.notes: Leaking valve threshold: discharge more than 3 K above AHU supply.

blocks.name: leak_valve_temperature_high
blocks.notes: OBC discharge temperature rise uses 0.25 K clearing hysteresis.

blocks.name: leak_valve_fan_and_closed
blocks.notes: AHU fan proven on while the measured valve is closed.

blocks.name: leak_valve_condition
blocks.notes: Warm discharge, closed valve, and fan proof must persist together.

blocks.name: leak_alarm_clear
